messages:
maria.g: FYI found a restore failure in staging when trying to mount tenant snapshot after yesterday's CMK rotation. error: AccessDenied on decrypt. Any quick ideas? @ajay.k @sophie
ajay.k: hmm. did we rotate grants or revoke backup-uploader role? check KMS grants
sophie: check CloudTrail for kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey calls + S3 GetObject events for PUT metadata
leo: run this in staging:
```
aws kms list-grants --key-id alias/rdw-backups
aws s3api head-object --bucket prod-backups-staging --key snapshots/2024-05-09-tenant123
``` 
maria.g: ran first one: empty list. 😬
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: incident created INC-2024-9812 and assigned to oncall rotation
ajay.k: if list-grants empty, maybe key was re-created (new key id) — need to check CMK alias history and KMS key rotation events
sophie: also confirm S3 objects have x-amz-server-side-encryption: aws:kms and x-amz-server-side-encryption-aws-kms-key-id header
maria.g: head-object shows SSE-KMS header present but key-id is arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/NEWKEYID
leo: that means old snapshots encrypted to OLDKEYID can't be decrypted by NEWKEYID. Were we rekeying snapshots? who ran the rotation?
ajay.k: I pushed a terraform change that replaced alias target (intended) but not the re-encryption step. should have followed backup-rekey playbook. apologies.
sophie: ok plan: 1) stop any further snapshot writes to this bucket (lock uploader role), 2) re-create grant for old key to backup-serviceaccount (if key still exists), 3) if old key scheduled for deletion, restore from key-escrow or use escrow-decrypt flow, 4) audit CloudTrail and S3 logs for any GetObject of affected snapshots (detect exfil).
maria.g: can someone run CloudTrail query and S3 access logs for tenant123 snapshots from 2024-05-09 to 2024-05-12? I don't want false positives.
leo: on it, running Athena query now — will dump results to internal bucket and link.
oncall-bot: @jordan-sre assigned to incident INC-2024-9812
ajay.k: also check RBAC: did we rotate the backup-uploader role id? I changed a role name earlier — make sure policy isn't implicitly denying kms:Decrypt via condition on resource tags.
sophie: add these audit items to playbook: - verify grants after alias updates - canary re-encrypt test in staging - admin approval gate for CMK swaps
maria.g: adding note to encops playbook and tagging legal for potential customer notification if there's any unauthorized access.
jordan-sre: Athena output link: s3://internal-temp/query-outputs/ct-tenant123-1754321000.csv — 0 GetObject except uploader service account. Nothing else.
maria.g: good, no exfil. Next steps: restore old key grant to uploader role, re-encrypt snapshots where possible, and run canary restore. I'll update the incident with remediation steps.
ajay.k: I can fast-path a grant if key exists. If old key deleted, we'll do escrow route.
sophie: also add a short postmortem checklist item: document "alias swap must not be performed until re-encrypt path or grants exist" :thumbsup:
maria.g: thanks team. follow-up sync 15:30.
